purpose: Learn target-environment action readiness and reusable preconditions from accepted/blocked feedback within and across target episodes, without simulator DAG access

evaluation.online_updates: One update for every observed action/outcome; persistent role-level evidence across prior evaluated episodes, no future data

permitted_evidence: public frame, own attempted action and its accepted/blocked response and eventual goal; no hidden prerequisite graph or true missing requirement labels
method: adaptive active probing with versioned outcome trace, replay-verifiable learned readiness evidence and bounded goal retry after relevant progress
baselines: simple goal-first then uniform untried roles
metrics: cold first20 success and warm last60 success per seed/family
target trial success versus static workshop model
restrictions: Do not change earlier frozen hidden-prerequisite benchmark or results
Role tags and 7-action vocabulary remain engineered, note role_order heuristic is powerful
No reward-based tuning to test results; keep first result even if fails
No external action authority; model checksums not signatures
Previously inspected seeds are NOT independent blind
Preserve AthenZ/Synveil separation and V2A-before-overlapping-V2B roadmap
